01 · SHARED CLIENT CASE

One shared client case

Preparing shared inputs…

Outside gains and equal cash inflows are shared across strategies. Terminal wealth includes these flows and cannot be interpreted as the CAGR on starting capital.

Shared candidate positions

Use one row per position, such as AAPL,long,1,IBM. Original and replacement tickers must all be distinct. Long/short directions stay fixed; D optimizes weights within those directions. B holds the original stocks as a long-only basket.

Costs and tax rates

The model uses the ST rate for ordinary income and the LT rate for dividends. Other client-specific tax considerations require separate inputs.

Trading, harvesting and risk rules

Checks occur at each daily close; the model does not reproduce full intraday broker risk controls. Switching back to an original stock requires a wait of more than 30 calendar days.

D: Optimization constraints and estimates

Exposure targets and position caps apply at rebalance; price changes can cause exposure and concentration to drift between trades. Risk estimates use only pre-trade history. The QP uses a local approximation of taxes on positive realized gains and does not turn unused losses directly into cash. The ledger settles actual modeled taxes annually. This version does not claim a globally optimal lifetime outcome.

3 × 3 = 9 paired cost scenarios. Each cell reruns all four strategies and adds calculation time.

Synthetic paths are conditional on the model and do not represent real-world future probabilities. All strategies share the same paths. The QP is solved again over time; start with a small number of paths.
